summary: All 31 required checks PASS. R1 closed the 12 CDP-driven web-fallback blocks from iter 1 by adding (a) three web demo pages under samples/cross_platform/web/, (b) a CDP harness at scripts/phase04_cdp_harness.cr that drives headless Chrome with trusted Input.dispatchKeyEvent / dispatchMouseEvent, axe-core 4.10.2 injection and IBM Equal Access 4.0.17 injection, focus-trap traces, escape/backdrop dismiss probes, positioning measurements across 1280×800 / 375×667 / 320×568, and touch-target rect assertions. R1 also fixed the Tier 2 heading off-by-one (54 → 55). R1's first harness run surfaced two latent renderer-source bugs: (1) color contrast 1.92:1 for action-sheet action buttons (failing WCAG-AA 4.5:1) and (2) `role="group"` on the action list `<ul>` orphaning its `<li>` children (axe listitem violation). R2 fixed both: web_renderer.cr:2721 swapped `--ap-color-brand-accent` → `--ap-color-brand-primary` (post-R2 contrast ≥ 5.05:1 on light/sunken, ≥ 8.72:1 on dark), and web_renderer.cr:2589 removed the role=group attribute. This iteration's harness re-run reports any_failed=false: all 18 CDP probes (12 routed + 6 supplementary path-control) return pass=true; axe-clean and IBM Equal Access return 0 serious/critical / 0 violation-level findings across all 4 viewport×scheme combos. Cross-target build matrix: web / iOS / macOS PASS; Android fails on Crystal stdlib epoll require (precedent B9, pre-existing host-environment, carried forward per architect adjudication). Crystal spec: 1347 examples, 4 failures = the 4 pre-existing baseline failures (1 UI::Theme inject_theme_css + 3 phase2_verification component-system specs) — zero new failures from Phase 4. Swift test 53/53 PASS. iOS XCUITest Phase03BehaviorTests 10/10 PASS. macOS AXTest 2/2 PASS (the iter-1 TCC flake did not reproduce — even cleaner). Ready to merge.
